content.short: ElementPay is a B2B stablecoin payments platform connecting USDC to mobile money and banks across Africa.
content.description: ElementPay is a B2B stablecoin payments platform building cross-border rails for Africa. It offers USDC invoicing, collections and payout APIs, and off-ramps that convert USDC to mobile money such as M-Pesa and local bank rails, along with USSD payment flows that work without internet and EUR and USD IBAN accounts for settlement. ElementPay uses USDC over networks including Base, Arbitrum and Starknet, connecting on-chain value to Africa's mobile-money and banking systems so businesses can pay staff, suppliers and partners quickly and cheaply. It serves fintechs, marketplaces, payroll platforms and exporters across markets like Kenya, Nigeria and Ghana.
content.meta: ElementPay provides B2B stablecoin payments and mobile-money off-ramps across Africa. Discover ElementPay and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
